_comment: Committed policy table. The screen resolves against this; it never infers. Edit here, never in a rule -- the license_version() digest over this file invalidates every affected screening checkpoint.
_allowed_provenance: Identical to scripts/collector/config.py ALLOWED_LICENSES, the gate every repository in both arms already passed at acquisition. One standard applied twice: once to the host repository, and once to the package code `spm isolate` carries into a transplant. A wider list would be a second standard, and would need its own justification.

phrases: Permission is hereby granted, free of charge

_markers_provenance: Every marker must appear in a LICENSE for it to be recognised as that id -- an AND, not an OR, because the three permissive texts quote each other in places and a single phrase is not enough to separate them. A LICENSE matching no id, or more than one, is UNRECOGNISED and therefore NOT allowed: the failure this table could otherwise introduce is waving through a licence nobody read. `match` was made explicit on 2026-09-05: the conjunction used to be a bare list whose operator lived only in the loader, so the file did not say what it meant. `all` is the only value implemented, and an unrecognised one raises rather than defaulting -- a silent default here is exactly the waving-through this table exists to prevent. The phrases are raw substrings, never regexes, so `.` and `(` in them are literal.
_aliases_provenance: `data/candidates.jsonl` stores GitHub's `license.spdx_id` LOWERCASED (scripts/collector/api.py). R18 compares against `allowed_spdx`, which is canonical SPDX, so the two vocabularies are reconciled here rather than by lowercasing the policy -- the policy is what a human reads.
